activation_disposition.reason: The only registered MASLD source matching SpatialMETA's spatial-transcriptomics plus spatial-metabolomics design is controlled, adjacent-section HRA007511, and implementation, patent, vendored-code, asset, join, and derivative-weight rights are unresolved.

architecture_contract.registration: Rotation, translation, scale, optional nonlinear distortion, and optional diffeomorphic refinement align the modalities before K-nearest-neighbor reassignment to a common resolution.
architecture_contract.cross_modal_assignment: The published workflow maps nearby spatial-metabolomics observations to spatial-transcriptomic spots and aggregates intensities; this is a derived registered estimate, not a same-section measurement.
architecture_contract.latent_model: Batch-invariant encoders and batch-conditioned decoders learn shared and modality-specific latent factors.
architecture_contract.modality_warning: RNA count and metabolite intensity likelihoods are assay-specific. Never port the count likelihood or its effect scale to MALDI intensities merely because the software accepts a matrix.

implementation.publication_title: Integrating cross-sample and cross-modal data for spatial transcriptomics and metabolomics with SpatialMETA

checkpoint_contract.rule: Every future donor-fold and seed produces a new state-dict identity bound to exact registration, reassignment, feature, scaler, batch-category, and training-donor receipts.

registration_and_reassignment_contract.adjacent_section_semantics: A registered value from an adjacent MALDI section remains a derived adjacent-section estimate with registration uncertainty. It is never relabeled as observed on the transcriptomic section.
registration_and_reassignment_contract.freeze_before_use: Lock the registration inputs, coordinate units, landmarks or outlines, affine and nonlinear stages, objective, initialization, iteration schedule, interpolation, K, distance threshold, aggregation, unmapped policy, and transform SHA-256.
registration_and_reassignment_contract.circularity_guard: If cross-modal recovery is evaluated, do not optimize registration on the same gene or metabolite signals used as evaluation truth. Use outcome-independent outline or histology registration, or a predeclared disjoint alignment-feature and evaluation-feature split.
registration_and_reassignment_contract.manual_registration: Manual landmarks or parameter choices informed by disease stage, model residuals, or held outcomes are prohibited.
registration_and_reassignment_contract.spatial_feature_selection: Spatially variable gene and metabolite selection, including any spatial-neighbor or Moran-statistic calculation, is fitted inside training donors only.

held_donor_capability.frozen_encoder_lane: Potentially supported after implementation: apply fixed feature orders, scaling, encoder weights, and registration rules to a new donor. The frozen latent encoder must not require a new learned donor category.
held_donor_capability.batch_conditioned_decoder_limit: The native decoder conditions on training-defined batch categories and is not automatically inductive for an unseen donor category. A fixed neutral or reference policy must be predeclared or decoder evaluation is ineligible.
held_donor_capability.query_registration: Computing a transform and KNN reassignment from a held donor's unlabeled images or coordinates is query-specific transductive preprocessing, even when model weights remain frozen.
held_donor_capability.query_adaptation: Any held-feature fine-tuning, re-estimation of scaling or spatial features, or addition of a donor batch embedding is a separately reported query-adaptive lane, not zero-shot.
held_donor_capability.split_rule: All sections, modalities, registrations, cores, and aliquots from one participant stay in one outer fold.

input_and_missingness_contract.feature_rosters: Freeze training-derived gene and metabolite identifiers, order, normalization, and mapping. Unmeasured features remain missing or out of domain, not zero.
input_and_missingness_contract.pairing: Record same_section, adjacent_section, same_sample_different_aliquot, or same_study_unpaired exactly. Registration does not upgrade topology.
input_and_missingness_contract.RNA: Preserve raw-count provenance and library-size semantics required by the RNA likelihood.
input_and_missingness_contract.metabolites: Preserve intensity scale, preprocessing, peak annotation confidence, ion mode, and below-detection status required by the metabolite likelihood.
input_and_missingness_contract.unpaired_data: Use only modes the pinned implementation natively supports and label any imputation or cross-modal prediction as derived_not_observed.

safe_loading_contract.core_model: The inspected core exposes an in-memory trained_state_dict but does not provide a complete immutable project-ready checkpoint and loader contract.
safe_loading_contract.optional_vendored_paths: Vendored optional modules include unrestricted torch.load calls. They and all external pretrained objects are prohibited unless separately pinned, terms-cleared, isolated, and converted to a tensor-only format.
safe_loading_contract.required_project_path: Serialize only a validated tensor state dictionary or safetensors plus schema-validated JSON. Require exact keys, shapes, dtypes, finite values, feature order, batch categories, likelihood configuration, transform hashes, and strict restoration with no network access.

runtime_contract.inconsistency: scikit-learn is 0.24.1 in setup.py but 1.5.0 in the repository requirements and environment declarations.
runtime_contract.required_probe: After rights clearance, activation, and campaign approval only: isolated L40S import, registration fixture, assay-native likelihood fixture, forward, backward, state-dict round-trip, resume, deterministic seed, donor block, no-network, and cross-device tolerance probes through SLURM.

terms_and_release_contract.top_level_code: BSD-3-Clause is present at the pinned repository revision and is reported by the paper.
terms_and_release_contract.patent: The paper reports Chinese patent application 2025110969999 covering the SpatialMETA algorithm. The BSD-3-Clause text has no explicit patent grant; institutional review is required before adaptation or open release.
terms_and_release_contract.vendored_stalign: SpatialMETA identifies its alignment model as modified from STalign. Upstream JEFworks-Lab/STalign is GPL-3.0, while the inspected SpatialMETA tree presents a top-level BSD license and no clear per-file GPL notice for the vendored modified copy. Exact reuse and redistribution obligations are unresolved.
terms_and_release_contract.vendored_taming_transformers: Vendored code derived from taming-transformers requires provenance and license-notice verification even though upstream is described as MIT.
terms_and_release_contract.hmdb_table: The repository includes a large HMDB-derived table. HMDB data terms and redistribution are independent of the source-code license; the table is prohibited unless separately audited and is not required for the core integration comparison.
terms_and_release_contract.training_data_and_weights: A locally trained model can be redistributed only if every spatial RNA, image, metabolite, annotation, registration, and derived-weight term permits it.
terms_and_release_contract.open_champion: ineligible while patent, vendored-code, asset, dataset, and derivative-weight terms remain unresolved

source_evidence: The Nature Communications article and supplement, official Zenodo record, official PyPI metadata, pinned GitHub source, upstream STalign repository, and referenced license files were inspected online on 2026-08-22. No archive, package, checkpoint, data asset, or code was downloaded, installed, or executed.
